description: This file provides lightweight helper utilities for interacting with an SQLite database, including functions to get database paths, manage connections, execute queries, and perform common ORM-like operations related to users, profiles, posts, and reactions in a social media context.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Determines the database file path from environment variable or default value.

methods.name: get_connection(db_path: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Provides a context-managed SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled.

methods.name: int execute(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = ())
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement that modifies data; returns last inserted row ID or -1.

methods.name: int executemany(sql: str, seq_params: Iterable[Iterable[Any]])
methods.description: Executes multiple SQL statements; returns number of affected rows.

methods.name: List[Tuple] fetch_all(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = ())
methods.description: Fetches all rows for a given SELECT statement.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple] fetch_one(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = ())
methods.description: Fetches a single row for a given SELECT statement.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_with_profile(user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user's data along with their profile details based on user ID.

methods.name: int create_post(user_id: int, content: str, media_url: Optional[str] = None, visibility: str = "public")
methods.description: Inserts a new post record associated with a user, returns the new post's ID.

methods.name: bool react_to_post(user_id: int, post_id: int, reaction_type: str)
methods.description: Inserts a reaction record for a post by a user; returns True if successful.

ctags.name: create_post
ctags.pattern: /^def create_post(user_id: int, content: str, media_url: Optional[str] = None, visibility: str = "/
ctags.signature: (user_id: int, content: str, media_url: Optional[str] = None, visibility: str = "public")

ctags.name: react_to_post
ctags.pattern: /^def react_to_post(user_id: int, post_id: int, reaction_type: str) -> bool:$/
